Inline comments:
In `@test/extended/node/node_e2e/node.go`:
- Line 183: The mirror-set teardown in the “[OTP] Create ImageDigestMirrorSet
and ImageTagMirrorSet…” spec is closing over the interruptible test ctx, so
cleanup can be canceled before deleting IDMS/ITMS and waiting for MCP recovery.
Update the g.DeferCleanup block to use a cleanup-scoped context derived for
teardown instead of the main ctx, and pass that cleanup context through the
delete-and-wait logic so the cluster-scoped resources are always removed even if
the test times out.

In `@test/extended/node/node_swap_cnv.go`:
- Around line 700-705: The deferred teardown blocks in the swap test are using
the main test ctx, so cleanup can stop early if the spec is canceled or times
out. Update each defer that performs teardown work around removeDropInFile,
swapoff, swapfile deletion, kubelet restarts, and ready waits to create and use
